spanish: Y el vestido, cuando fuere en él plaga de lepra, en vestido de lana o en vestido de lino,
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated transliteration 'tsaráat' (H6883, common noun) into the Spanish 'lepra', matching the project's own Spanish rendering of this noun elsewhere (e.g. v.2 'plaga de lepra').
readerNote: Kept 'lino' as a singular mass noun for the plural פשתים (H6593), the same material-plural-to-singular pattern already used for lana; no participants or clause roles were touched.
